mapper.select: select * from review_cases where id=#{id}
select * from review_cases where id=#{id} for update
mapper.update: update review_cases set after_json=#{afterJson},reason=#{reason},status=#{status},node=#{node}, supervisor_id=#{supervisorId},finance_id=#{financeId},first_actor_id=#{firstActorId},sensitive=#{sensitive}, round=#{round},revision=revision+1,updated_at=now(), active_key=case when #{status} in('APPLIED','CANCELLED','REVOKED') then null else concat(type,':',target_id) end where id=#{id} and revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: select user_id,nick_name,dept_id,rank_level from sys_user where user_id=#{id} and status='0' and del_flag='0'
select user_id,nick_name,dept_id,rank_level from sys_user where user_id=#{id} and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update
select user_id,nick_name,dept_id,rank_level from sys_user where status='0' and del_flag='0' order by nick_name
mapper.sql: from sys_user u join sys_user_role ur on ur.user_id=u.user_id join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id where u.user_id=#{id} and u.status='0' and u.del_flag='0' and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(*) and r.role_key=#{role}
select count(*) and exists(select 1 from sys_role_menu rm join sys_menu m on m.menu_id=rm.menu_id where rm.role_id=r.role_id and m.status='0' and m.perms=#{permission})
select * from review_config where type=#{type} and target_key=#{targetKey} and dept_id=#{deptId}
select * from review_config order by type,dept_id,target_key
select count(*) from review_events where case_id=#{caseId} and request_key=#{key} and actor_id=#{actorId}

select cast(e.id as char) as id,e.action,e.comment,e.round,e.created_at as createdAt,u.nick_name as actorName, cast(e.responsible_id as char) as responsibleId,cast(e.delegation_id as char) as delegationId,e.snapshot from review_events e left join sys_user u on u.user_id=e.actor_id where e.case_id=#{id} order by e.created_at,e.id
select cast(id as char) as id,file_name as name,sha256,created_at as createdAt from review_files where case_id=#{id} order by created_at
select storage_path as path,file_name as name from review_files where case_id=#{id} and id=#{fileId}
select * from approval_delegation where agent_id=#{agentId} and status='ACTIVE' and starts_at<=now() and ends_at>now()
select * from approval_delegation where id=#{id}
select * from approval_delegation where id=#{id} for update
mapper.update: update approval_delegation set status=#{status} where id=#{id}

update approval_delegation set principal_id=#{principalId},agent_id=#{agentId},dept_id=#{deptId},principal_dept_id=#{principalDeptId},agent_dept_id=#{agentDeptId},type=#{type},node=#{node},max_cents=#{maxCents},starts_at=#{startsAt},ends_at=#{endsAt},status='PENDING' where id=#{id} and status<>'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: select count(*) from approval_delegation where id<>#{id} and principal_id=#{principalId} and type=#{type} and node=#{node} and dept_id=#{deptId} and status in('PENDING','ACTIVE') and starts_at<#{endsAt} and ends_at>#{startsAt}
select count(*) from approval_delegation where id<>#{id} and status in('PENDING','ACTIVE') and starts_at<#{endsAt} and ends_at>#{startsAt} and (agent_id=#{principalId} or principal_id=#{agentId})

select count(*) from approval_actor_events where business_type=#{type} and business_id=#{businessId} and round_key=#{round} and node<>#{node} and action='APPROVE' and (actor_id=#{person} or responsible_id=#{person})
